## **ER1.2. SECTION 2 - ACTUAL UNIT COSTS INCURRED BY THE USERS**

### **ER1.2.1. FOCUS ON EN ROUTE AUCU MONITORING AT CHARGING ZONE LEVEL**

The actual en route unit cost incurred by airspace users (AUCU) in respect of activities performed in 2025 (54.76 €) is -6.4% lower than the nominal DUC (58.50 €). The difference between these two figures (-3.75 €/SU) is due to:

- the positive inflation adjustment resulting from higher than planned inflation (+0.23 €/SU);

- the impact of adjustments resulting from the costs exempted from cost sharing mechanism (-1.63 €/SU);

- the deduction of the traffic risk sharing adjustments (-0.64 €/SU);

- the deduction of the traffic adjustment (-0.31 €/SU) for the costs not subject to traffic risk sharing;

- the impact of financial incentives (-0.48 €/SU);

- cross-financing between Spain Canarias and Spain Continental en route charging zones (+1.00 €/SU); and,

- the deduction of other revenues (-1.91 €/SU).

The share of the regulatory result (see next sub-section) in the AUCU (before the deduction of other revenues) is 7.3%.
